document_api_meta.title: Create FBT MCF Order
document_api_meta.env_desc: For orders created on other sales channels that require fulfillment via FBT, this API enables you to create corresponding orders (hereinafter referred to as MCF Orders). Once MCF Orders are successfully created, they will be automatically submitted to the FBT system for fulfillment.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: external_order_id
request_body_param.desc: The corresponding order ID in your OMS. Maximum UTF-8 length: 127 bytes. It must be unique among active MCF orders for the same merchant. Reusing an `external_order_id` from an active order is rejected as a duplicate and is not an idempotent retry.

request_body_param.name: goods
request_body_param.desc: The item IDs and quantities included in the order. The array must contain at least one item, and each item must be managed in the FBT system. The sum of `quantity` across all entries in `goods` must not exceed 50.

request_body_param.name: ^id
request_body_param.desc: The goods ID generated by the Fulfilled by TikTok system. The value must be a positive base-10 integer string.

request_body_param.name: ^quantity
request_body_param.desc: The quantity of this item. Must be greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^name
request_body_param.desc: The consignee name. Must not exceed 128 UTF-8 bytes.

request_body_param.name: ^address
request_body_param.desc: The consignee address must be a valid address; if the address verification fails, no order will be created.

request_body_param.name: ^^country_code
request_body_param.desc: The consignee address country code in two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Only `US` is accepted.

request_body_param.name: ^^postal_code
request_body_param.desc: The 5-digit US ZIP code for the consignee address.

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^mcf_order
response_param.desc: Information about the successfully created MCF order. On a successful response, this object contains `mcf_order_id`, `external_order_id`, and `create_time`.

response_param.name: ^^external_order_id
response_param.desc: The corresponding order ID in your OMS.

response_param.name: ^^mcf_order_id
response_param.desc: A unique ID that identifies different MCF orders

response_param.name: ^^create_time
response_param.desc: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the MCF order was created.

// For more details about the SDK, refer to the documentation:
// https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/67c83e0799a75104986ae498
func fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderPost() {
    configuration := apis.NewConfiguration()
    configuration.AddAppInfo(appKey, appSecret)
    apiClient := apis.NewAPIClient(configuration)
    request := apiClient.FbtV202607API.Fbt202607McfOutboundOrdersPost(context.Background())
    request = request.XTtsAccessToken("your access token")
    request = request.ContentType("application/json")
    request = request.ShopCipher("your shop cipher")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody := fbt_v202607.NewFbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody()
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody.SetExternalOrderId("shopify202208291503530001100220033")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoods := fbt_v202607.NewFbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoods()
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoods.SetId("1234567")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoods.SetQuantity(1)
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoodsList := []fbt_v202607.Fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoods{*fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoods}
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody.SetGoods(fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyGoodsList)
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee := fbt_v202607.NewFbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee()
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee.SetName("username")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee.SetPhoneNumber("(+1)1211223910")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee.SetEmail("username@example.com")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress := fbt_v202607.NewFbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress()
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetCountryCode("US")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetStateOrRegion("Alabama")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetDistrictOrCounty("Baldwin")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetCity("Bay Minette")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetAddressLine1("312 Courthouse Square")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetAddressLine2("Suite 10")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress.SetPostalCode("36507")
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee.SetAddress(*fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsigneeAddress)
    fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody.SetConsignee(*fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBodyConsignee)
    request = request.Fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody(*fbt202607CreateFBTMCFOrderRequestBody)
    resp, httpResp, err := request.Execute()
    if err != nil || httpResp.StatusCode != 200 {
        fmt.Printf("productsRequest err:%v resbody:%s", err, httpResp.Body)
        return
    }
    if resp == nil {
        fmt.Printf("response is nil")
        return
    }
    if resp.GetCode()!= 0 {
        fmt.Printf("response business is error, errorCode:%d errorMessage:%s", resp.GetCode(), resp.GetMessage())
        return
    }
    respDataJson, _ := json.MarshalIndent(resp.GetData(), "", "  ")
    fmt.Println("response data:", string(respDataJson))
    return
}
